title: Microservice Generation
short_description: Generate complete microservice implementations from requirements and codebase context.
long_description: Given a microservice specification and project context, generate a complete, functional microservice implementation including controllers, services, data models, configuration, and tests. Two generation scenarios are supported: Incremental (target service removed but surrounding codebase remains, evaluated with unit tests) and Clean State (all traces removed, generate from requirements alone, evaluated with integration tests). Two prompting strategies are available: minimal context (P1) and detailed implementation summary (P2). Submissions are evaluated on test pass rates, code quality (SLOC, cyclomatic/cognitive complexity), and efficiency (time, cost, tokens).

metrics.name: Test Pass Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of test cases passed - unit tests for incremental, integration tests for clean state generation

metrics.name: Source Lines of Code (SLOC)
metrics.description: Quantifies program size by counting lines containing source code

metrics.name: Cyclomatic Complexity
metrics.description: Measures control flow complexity and testability of the generated microservice code

metrics.name: Cognitive Complexity
metrics.description: Measures code understandability of the generated microservice implementation

metrics.name: Generation Time
metrics.description: Total time from generation start to completion in minutes

metrics.name: Generation Cost
metrics.description: Associated monetary costs based on each agent's pricing model using API pricing

test_cases.description: Unit tests for incremental generation and integration tests for clean state generation across 4 projects with 3 microservices each

generation_scenarios.incremental: Target microservice code removed but codebase, dependencies, and integration points remain intact. Agents explore existing architecture.
generation_scenarios.clean_state: All implementation traces removed. Agents generate from requirements specifications alone, without access to existing code.
